message: Hey everyone! So, we all know that power outages can happen when we least expect them, right? I find it super helpful to have a plan in place, and this guide from the Red Cross has some great tips for preparing. It’s nice to share ideas in the family group chat about how we can make the best of it—think cozy candlelight dinners and board games! What’s your go-to tip for keeping the family calm during a blackout? 🌟
